title: Game of the Week: Ohio State @ Nebraska (Week 12)
parts:
🏈 PROSPECT GAME OF THE WEEK

Ohio State @ Nebraska | Sat 12:00 ET · FOX

12 top-100 Alpha Draft Signal prospects with real roles take the field in Lincoln. 6 are freshmen or sophomores.

The #1 WR on the board, a freshman Buckeye QB and a Husker freshman back. 🧵👇

🎯 Jeremiah Smith | WR | Ohio State | JR | 5⭐

#1 WR in the Alpha Draft Signal.

10 gms: 80 rec, 1,317 yds, 15 TD

100+ yards in 6 of 10 games, topped by 217. That's 42.7% of Ohio State's receiving yards.

Smith gets Nebraska at noon ET. Who goes for 100? 👇
